description: World Power: country electricity profile. One call returns a country's electricity in numbers: generation by fuel (TWh) and shares for 2025 (or 2024), change vs the previous year, fossil and low-carbon share, carbon intensity (gCO2e/kWh), demand, net imports, power-sector emissions, installed plant capacity by fuel and the five largest plants. 214 countries plus World and regions. Values as published by Ember, the Energy Institute and WRI; nothing estimated. Routes: /; /mix (country*, year); /answer (country*, year); /countries (limit, offset). Paid $0.5 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /, /mix, /answer, /countries. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.

name: world-power
